description: Start an originality check of ONE document for the user (PDF, DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF or TXT, 100 to 10,000 words; shorter texts are refused without using any limit). Ask the user's permission first. Returns a token; the check takes 10 to 20 minutes. Send exactly one of content_base64 (with filename), text, or url. Open access has growing waiting times between checks and a small daily limit; never send batches or split documents.

filename.description: file name with extension, e.g. thesis.pdf (with content_base64)

url.description: a public link to a PDF, DOCX or TXT file

user_confirmed.description: true only after the user agreed to send the document to OpenPlag Labs

name: check_document
